description: Northwind Analytics is hiring a Data Analyst to support its retail reporting team. You will build dashboards, maintain data pipelines feeding weekly business reviews, and work with stakeholders to define new metrics.
requirements: 3+ years in a data analyst or BI role
Strong SQL and at least one BI tool (Power BI or Tableau)
Comfortable presenting findings to non-technical stakeholders
Experience with retail or e-commerce data is a plus
fit: Several years of hands-on SQL and dashboarding work line up directly with the core reporting responsibilities.
Comfortable presenting to non-technical stakeholders, which the listing calls out explicitly.
gaps: No direct retail or e-commerce experience; the listing lists it as a plus, not a requirement.
The listing doesn't say which BI tool is in use — confirm before the interview.
unclear: Which BI tool the team actually uses (Power BI or Tableau) is not stated in the listing.
notes: Recruiter mentioned a short take-home exercise may follow the first screen.

description: A 6-month contract supporting Contoso Health's clinical operations reporting. Deliverables are a handful of recurring reports and one new quarterly dashboard.
requirements: Healthcare or another regulated industry background preferred
fit: Recurring report-building experience matches the contract's deliverables closely.
gaps: No healthcare or regulated-industry background, which the listing prefers.
Contract length (6 months) is shorter than the roles usually targeted.
unclear: Not stated whether the contract could extend or convert to a permanent role.

description: Fabrikam Logistics is growing its ops analytics function. The role owns on-time delivery reporting and partners with the warehouse network on process improvements.
requirements: Analyst experience in logistics, supply chain or manufacturing
Advanced Excel; SQL is a strong plus
Comfortable on-site with warehouse operations teams
Prior exposure to WMS or ERP data
fit: Ops analytics background in a comparable industry (manufacturing) matches well.
Advanced Excel and some SQL cover the listed tools.
gaps: No direct WMS experience; the listing mentions a WMS migration as a current project.
notes: Panel interview is with the ops director and two analysts. Ask about the WMS migration mentioned in the listing.

description: Adatum Retail sought a lead to run its customer insights function, owning a small analyst team and the roadmap for a new customer data platform.
requirements: 5+ years in customer insights or CRM analytics
Comfortable owning a roadmap, not just delivering reports
fit: Strong customer insights and CRM analytics background.
gaps: No formal people-management experience, and the role leads a small team.
Roadmap ownership experience so far has been in a supporting role, not the lead.
unclear: Unclear how many direct reports the team lead role would actually have.
notes: Rejected after the first screen: they wanted more hands-on people-management experience than this role has had so far.

description: Part-time commercial analyst role (3 days/week) supporting Tailspin Energy's pricing team with margin analysis and competitor tracking.
requirements: Energy sector experience is a plus, not required
fit: Commercial/pricing analyst background and strong Excel modelling match the core of the role.
gaps: No energy-sector experience, though the listing says this is a plus, not required.
unclear: Not clear whether the 3-day schedule is fixed or can flex week to week.
notes: Confirm part-time hours are still 3 days/week before the next step.
